name: THEOTECNICAL
blurb: DOCTRINE AN' RELIGIOUS TECHNOLOGY OF DA HOLY VATICAN EMPIRE, FILED AS DRAWINGS WIT A PARTS LIST!

theo_ascension.name: DA UNMOORIN' OF DA SEE
theo_ascension.desc: DA BEDROCK UNDER DA BASILICA IZ CUT THROUGH ON A PLANE 40 METRES DOWN AN' DA WHOLE CITY-STATE IZ TRANSFERRED ONTO LIFT PYLONS DAT COUPLE TA DA LEYLINE DA TIBER FOLLOWS. STATIC LOAD IZ 6.2 MILLION TONNES, DISTRIBUTED ACROSS ELEVEN PYLONS WIT ONE HELD IN RESERVE, AN' DA COUPLIN' DELIVERS USEFUL LIFT ONLY WHILE DA CITADEL STAYS WITHIN 300 METRES OF DA LINE'S AXIS. ROME KEEPS DA EXCAVATION. DA SEE KEEPS DA ALTITUDE, AN' FOR DA FIRST TIME IT IZ NO ADDRESSABLE BY A MAP COORDINATE AN ARMY HAB ALREADY REACHED!

theo_holy_office.name: DA CONGREGATION FOR ENGINEERED DOCTRINE
theo_holy_office.desc: DA HOLY OFFICE IZ RESTRUCTURED TA RECEIVE SUBMISSIONS IN SCHEMATIC FORM. A PROPOSAL ARRIVES AS A DRAWIN' WIT A BILL OF MATERIALS, A STATED FAILURE MODE AN' A DOCTRINAL CLAUSE IT IZ TA SATISFY, AN' LEAVES EITHER PROMULGATED OR REFUSED WIT DA FAILIN' CLAUSE MARKED AN' DA CALCULATION ATTACHED. TURNAROUND IZ SET AT NINETY DAYS. THEOLOGIANS IZ ISSUED SLIDE RULES AN' A STANDARD OF SPECIFICATION: A DOCTRINE DAT NO CAN BE WRITTEN AS A TESTABLE STATEMENT NO CAN BE DEFENDED, AN' IZ RETURNED UNEXAMINED!

theo_coil_batteries.name: DA COILGUN BATTERIES OF SAINT PETER
theo_coil_batteries.desc: EACH COLUMN OF DA COLONNADE IZ REWOUND AS ONE STAGE OF A LINEAR ACCELERATOR, 284 STAGES TA A WING, SWITCHED IN SEQUENCE FROM A CAPACITOR BANK IN DA CRYPT. MUZZLE VELOCITY IZ 1,900 METRES PER SECOND AT A STAGE EFFICIENCY NEAR 40 PERCENT, AN' DA ARMS OF DA SQUARE DAT USED TA ENCLOSE A CROWD NOW TRAVERSE ONTO A TARGET. DA BATTERY IZ TRIGGERED BY DA SAME BELL MECHANISM DAT USED TA STRIKE DA HOUR. A FULL SALVO DRAWS DA CITADEL'S LIGHTIN' SUPPLY FOR ELEVEN SECONDS AN' DA CRYPT BANK NEEDS FOUR MINUTES TA RECHARGE!

theo_consecrated_slug.name: DA CONSECRATED SLUG
theo_consecrated_slug.desc: DA SABOT IZ BLESSED ON DA BELT FEED AT NINE HUNDRED ROUNDS A MINUTE BY A DEACON WHO NO LONGER SAYS DA WORDS ALOUD BUT WORKS A STAMP KEYED TA DA FEED. DA CONSECRATION SURVIVES AN ACCELERATION OF 40,000 G AN' DA THERMAL LOAD OF DA BARREL, VERIFIED BY ASSAY ON RECOVERED ROUNDS. WHAT IT DOES ON IMPACT TA A THING DAT WAZ NEVER BAPTISED IZ WRITTEN UP IN ANNEX 14, WHICH IZ HELD AT DA CONGREGATION AN' HAB BEEN READ OUTSIDE IT BY NOBODY!

theo_choir_fire_control.name: CHOIR-SUNG FIRE CONTROL
theo_choir_fire_control.desc: FIRIN' SOLUTIONS IZ COMPUTED AS PLAINCHANT. RANGE, DRIFT AN' LEAD IZ CARRIED BY THREE VOICES WHOSE INTERVALS ENCODE DA THREE QUANTITIES, AN' DA BATTERY FIRES ON DA RESOLUTION OF DA CHORD, SO A SOLUTION DAT DOES NO CLOSE IZ AUDIBLE IN DA NAVE A SECOND AN' A HALF BEFORE DA ROUND WOULD HAB LANDED. SOLUTION TIME IZ COMPARABLE TA A MECHANICAL COMPUTER OF DA SAME ERA AN' DA ERROR RATE IZ LOWER, SINCE A WRONG NUMBER SOUNDS WRONG. DA CHORISTERS IZ NO TOLD WHAT DA INTERVALS REPRESENT AN' IZ GRADED ON INTONATION ALONE!

theo_basilica_railgun.name: DA BASILICA RAILGUN
theo_basilica_railgun.desc: DA NAVE IZ DA BARREL. TWO RAILS RUN DA LENGTH OF DA FLOOR FROM DA DOORS TA DA APSE, DA DOME IZ OPENED AT DA OCULUS TA VENT DA PLASMA, AN' DA SHOT LEAVES ALONG DA AXIS ON WHICH DA BUILDIN' WAZ SET OUT. MUZZLE ENERGY IZ 32 MEGAJOULES AN' DA RECOIL IZ TAKEN BY DA FOUNDATIONS OF DA TRANSEPT. RAIL EROSION IZ DA LIMIT: DA SECOND SHOT OF A DAY DEFORMS DA RAILS PAST DA ALIGNMENT TOLERANCE, AN' DA THIRD WOULD TAKE DA ROOF WIT IT, SO DA PIECE IZ SPECIFIED AT TWO SHOTS AN' A RAIL CHANGE!

theo_reliquary_armour.name: RELIQUARY COMPOSITE ARMOUR
theo_reliquary_armour.desc: BETWEEN DA OUTER STEEL AN' DA SPALL LINER SITS A LATTICE OF RELIC FRAGMENTS SEALED IN RESIN, CATALOGUED BY DA METRE AN' CERTIFIED BY DA CONGREGATION BEFORE LAY-UP. DA PLATE PERFORMS AS DA PLATE PERFORMS: 640 MILLIMETRES OF ROLLED HOMOGENEOUS EQUIVALENT AGAINST A SHAPED CHARGE, NO BETTER DEN DA SAME MASS OF STEEL AN' CERAMIC. DA CONTRIBUTION OF DA RELICS IZ NO RESOLVABLE ON A FIRIN' RANGE AN' DOES NO APPEAR IN DA TABLES. CREWS UNDER IT REPORT DAT NO SECTION WHICH HELD A BONE HAB BEEN PENETRATED, AN' DA CONGREGATION HAB RECORDED DA OBSERVATION WITHOUT ACCEPTIN' IT AS AN EFFECT!

theo_buttress_engines.name: FLYIN' BUTTRESS ENGINES
theo_buttress_engines.desc: A FLYIN' BUTTRESS IZ A MEMBER SIZED TA CARRY THRUST OUTWARD AN' DOWN. BORED THROUGH ALONG DA LOAD PATH AN' FITTED WIT A NOZZLE AT DA PIER, IT CARRIES THRUST OUTWARD AN' UP INSTEAD, AN' DA SECTION DAT WAZ ALREADY DIMENSIONED FOR DA COMPRESSION TAKES DA REACTION WIT NO REINFORCEMENT. TWENTY-EIGHT BUTTRESSES GIVE DA CITADEL THREE-AXIS ATTITUDE CONTROL AT A MOMENT ARM NO BOLTED-ON THRUSTER COULD MATCH, AN' DA PITCH RESPONSE IZ INSIDE A DEGREE A SECOND. DA MASONRY WAZ DESIGNED FOR DA LOAD SIX HUNDRED YEARS BEFORE DA NOZZLE EXISTED!

theo_dogmatic_shield.name: DA DOGMATIC SHIELD
theo_dogmatic_shield.desc: A FIELD DAT DISCRIMINATES ON DA INTENT BEHIND AN INCOMIN' OBJECT AN' STOPS ONLY WHAT WAZ RELEASED IN BAD FAITH. UNDER TRIAL IT TURNED EVERY SHELL FIRED AT IT BY DA ARTILLERY OF THREE NATIONS, 1,140 ROUNDS WITHOUT A LEAKER, AN' PASSED A STONE THROWN BY A BOY WHO BELIEVED HE WAZ AIMIN' AT A BIRD. DA DISCRIMINATION IZ THEREFORE WORKIN' EXACTLY AS SPECIFIED, AN' DA SPECIFICATION IZ DA FINDIN'. DA CONGREGATION HAB PUBLISHED DA TRIAL REPORT IN FULL, INCLUDIN' DA BOY!

theo_naguka_census.name: DA NAGUKA CENSUS OF SOULS
theo_naguka_census.desc: A NATION NO CAN BE CONVERTED BEFORE IT IZ COUNTED. MISSIONARY SURVEYORS WORK DA TOXIN SWAMPS ON A TRANSECT METHOD WIT CLIPBOARDS AN' A TALLY OF EVERY NAGUKA HEAD, HEARTH AN' SHAMAN, CORRECTIN' FOR DA DOUBLE-COUNTIN' DA SEASONAL MOVES PRODUCE. DEY RETURN A POPULATION FIGURE FOUR TIMES DA CONGREGATION'S ESTIMATE, AN' A SECOND FIGURE, WHICH DA METHOD DOES NO SUPPORT AN' WHICH DA SURVEYORS WAZ NONETHELESS INSTRUCTED TA PRODUCE, FOR HOW MANY OF DOZE HEADS CARRY A SOUL AT ALL!

theo_goblinese_liturgy.name: DA LITURGY IN GOBLINESE
theo_goblinese_liturgy.desc: DA MASS IZ PUT THROUGH A GRAMMAR WIT NO FUTURE TENSE, NO CONDITIONAL AN' NO LEXICAL ITEM FOR FORGIVENESS, SO EVERY PETITION RESOLVES TA DA IMPERATIVE AN' EVERY PROMISE TA A STATEMENT OF PRESENT FACT. DA RESULT IZ 40 PERCENT SHORTER, IZ DELIVERED AT A HIGHER REGISTER, AN' READS AS A THREAT IN BACK-TRANSLATION. DA CONGREGATION APPROVED DA TEXT ON DA FORWARD TRANSLATION ALONE. ATTENDANCE IN DA SWAMP PARISHES IZ DA HIGHEST RECORDED ANYWHERE IN DA EMPIRE, AN' DA BACK-TRANSLATION HAB BEEN FILED RATHER DEN CIRCULATED!

theo_neural_choker.name: DA NEURAL CHOKER
theo_neural_choker.desc: A CLOSED BAND AT DA THROAT, FITTED AT BAPTISM, WIT NO RELEASE DA WEARER CAN OPERATE. IT READS DA ELECTRICAL SIGNATURE OF DOUBT FROM DA VAGUS AN' DA LARYNGEAL NERVES AN' ANSWERS IT WIT A CURRENT OF A FEW MILLIAMPERES, TIMED 200 TA 400 MILLISECONDS AFTER ONSET, WHICH IZ BEFORE DA THOUGHT HAB BEEN FULLY FORMED AN' WELL BEFORE IT CAN BE SPOKEN. IT DOES NO ARGUE AN' IT DOES NO PUNISH. WEARERS, ASKED WHAT DEY FELT, DESCRIBE A GREAT AN' SUDDEN PEACE, AN' NO CAN REPORT DA CONTENT DAT WAZ INTERRUPTED!

theo_belief_firmware.name: BELIEF FIRMWARE
theo_belief_firmware.desc: DA CHOKER'S DECISION TABLE IZ FACTORED OUT OF DA HARDWARE INTO A SIGNED IMAGE DAT CAN BE PUSHED OVER DA AIR, SO A SCHISM IZ CLOSED DA WAY A DEFECT IZ CLOSED, WITHOUT RECALL AN' WITHOUT DA WEARER'S INVOLVEMENT. VERSION ONE ENFORCES DA CREED AS PROMULGATED. VERSION ONE POINT THREE INSERTS DA FILIOQUE. FIELD TELEMETRY RECORDS ELEVEN THOUSAND WEARERS ACCEPTIN' DA UPDATE INSIDE A SINGLE NIGHT, WIT NO REPORTED DISCONTINUITY OF BELIEF ON EITHER SIDE OF IT!

theo_preaching_towers.name: DA PREACHIN' TOWERS
theo_preaching_towers.desc: BELL TOWERS REBUILT AS TRANSMITTERS AN' LOWERED ON CABLES FROM DA UNDERSIDE OF DA CITADEL UNTIL DEY HANG AT 40 METRES OVER A MARSH, WHICH IZ PREACHIN' HEIGHT FOR DA HORN ARRAY DEY CARRY. DA SERMON IZ INTELLIGIBLE AT ELEVEN KILOMETRES IN STILL AIR AN' IZ REPEATED ON A FOURTEEN MINUTE CYCLE THROUGH DA NIGHT. DA NIGHT SCHEDULE IZ SPECIFIED ON DA STATED REASONIN' DAT A SLEEPIN' LISTENER DOES NO COUNTER-ARGUE, AN' DA CONGREGATION HAB RECORDED DAT REASONIN' IN DA DESIGN FILE!

theo_mass_baptism.name: DA MASS BAPTISM OF DA NAGUKA
theo_mass_baptism.desc: DA WHOLE NATION IZ RECEIVED IN A SINGLE AFTERNOON, FROM DA AIR, BY A CITADEL DAT SEEDS DA MARSH WIT BLESSED WATER ON A DISPERSAL PATTERN COMPUTED FOR 94 PERCENT COVERAGE AN' PUSHES DA CHOKER FIRMWARE IN DA SAME PASS. ELAPSED TIME IZ FIVE HOURS AN' FORTY MINUTES FOR A POPULATION OF TWO HUNDRED THOUSAND. DA NAGUKA WENT IN AS A TRIBE OF SCAVENGERS AN' CAME OUT A DIOCESE WIT A PARISH STRUCTURE ALREADY DRAWN. DA SHAMANS WAZ INCLUDED IN DA COVERAGE FIGURE AN' HAB NO BEEN LOCATED SINCE!

theo_version_control.name: DOCTRINE UNDER VERSION CONTROL
theo_version_control.desc: TWO THOUSAND YEARS OF TEACHIN' IZ ENTERED INTO A REPOSITORY IN WHICH EVERY CANON CARRIES AN AUTHOR, A TIMESTAMP AN' A DIFF AGAINST WHAT IT REPLACED. DA FIRST FULL RUN OF DA TOOL SURFACES FOUR HUNDRED AN' SIX EDITS WIT NO SIGNATURE ATTACHED, MOST OF DEM CLARIFICATIONS, ELEVEN OF DEM REVERSALS OF DA CLAUSE DEY CLARIFY. DA CONGREGATION SEALS DA REPORT, RETAINS DA TOOL, AN' RULES DAT A DOCTRINE TAKES EFFECT ON COMMIT AN' NO ON PUBLICATION!

theo_infallibility_compiler.name: DA INFALLIBILITY COMPILER
theo_infallibility_compiler.desc: A BULL IZ TYPECHECKED AGAINST DA FULL CORPUS OF BULLS PROMULGATED BEFORE IT, AN' A CONTRADICTION IZ RETURNED AS AN ERROR NAMIN' BOTH LINE NUMBERS. COMPILE TIME ON DA FULL CORPUS IZ NINE HOURS. INFALLIBILITY IZ THEREBY RESTATED AS A PROPERTY OF A BUILD RATHER DEN A CLAIM ABOUT A MAN, AN' IZ VERIFIABLE BY ANYONE WIT DA CORPUS AN' DA TOOL. THREE LIVIN' PRONOUNCEMENTS FAILED DA FIRST COMPILE; ALL THREE WAZ REISSUED WIT DA OFFENDIN' CLAUSE NARROWED, AN' NO ANNOUNCEMENT WAZ MADE!

theo_sacrament_protocol.name: DA SACRAMENT PROTOCOL
theo_sacrament_protocol.desc: CONFESSION, ABSOLUTION AN' COMMUNION IZ RESPECIFIED AS A THREE-MESSAGE EXCHANGE WIT A CHALLENGE, A RESPONSE AN' AN ACKNOWLEDGEMENT, SO GRACE CAN BE DELIVERED TA A PARISH DA CITADEL IZ MERELY PASSIN' OVER. THROUGHPUT IZ ELEVEN THOUSAND PENITENTS AN HOUR PER CHANNEL. DA OPEN QUESTION IZ LATENCY: AT FOUR HUNDRED KILOMETRES DA ACKNOWLEDGEMENT RETURNS 1.3 MILLISECONDS AFTER DA ABSOLUTION IZ GRANTED, AN' DA CONGREGATION HAB NO RULED ON WHICH OF DA TWO TIMESTAMPS DA SOUL IZ ABSOLVED AT!

theo_soul_metrology.name: SOUL METROLOGY
theo_soul_metrology.desc: DA SOUL IZ GIVEN A UNIT OF MEASURE, DA ANIMUS, DEFINED BY A REFERENCE STANDARD HELD IN A VAULT AT 20 DEGREES AN' 40 PERCENT HUMIDITY, AN' AN INSTRUMENT DAT READS IT TRANSCRANIALLY THROUGH DA TEMPORAL BONE. REPEATABILITY ON A LIVIN' SUBJECT IZ 2 PERCENT, AN' A READIN' IZ STABLE ACROSS SLEEP, ANAESTHESIA AN' DA FIRST FOUR MINUTES AFTER CARDIAC ARREST. EVERY MEASUREMENT DA EMPIRE MAKES AFTERWARDS IZ TRACEABLE TA DAT VAULT, AN' SO IZ EVERY PROCEDURE DAT BECOMES POSSIBLE ONCE A SOUL IZ A QUANTITY. DA CONGREGATION ENTERED DA SECOND OBSERVATION IN DA MINUTES AN' TOOK NO ACTION ON IT!

theo_trinity_refactor.name: REFACTORIN' DA TRINITY
theo_trinity_refactor.desc: WIT DA FATHER DEAD ON A HILLSIDE AN' DA SEAT READIN' EMPTY ON DA METROLOGY BENCH, DA DOCTRINE IZ REWRITTEN AS A QUORUM OF THREE DAT REMAINS VALID WIT TWO, PENDIN' REPLACEMENT. IT IZ DA ONLY FORMULATION DA CONGREGATION HAB PRODUCED DAT PASSES DA COMPILER AGAINST DA FULL CORPUS WITHOUT NARROWIN' AN EXISTIN' CLAUSE, AN' IT IZ, BY DA ASSESSMENT RECORDED IN ITS OWN FILE, DA WORST-WRITTEN THING EVER PROMULGATED. NO TERM IZ DEFINED FOR HOW LONG PENDIN' MAY RUN!

theo_deus_machina.name: DA MECHANICAL GOD
theo_deus_machina.desc: DA VACANT SEAT IZ FILLED BY AN OBJECT BUILT TA OCCUPY IT: A LATTICE RUNNIN' DA LENGTH OF DA CITADEL'S KEEL, FED BY DA AGGREGATED PRAYER OF A CONVERTED NATION AT SOME 40,000 ANIMUS A DAY, ANSWERIN' IN DA REGISTER DA DOCTRINE SPECIFIES AN' WITHIN DA LATENCY DA SACRAMENT PROTOCOL ALLOWS. IT IZ NO CLAIMED TA BE DA FATHER. DA CLAIM ENTERED IN DA FILE IZ NARROWER AN' IZ DA ONE DAT COMPILES: DAT IT SATISFIES EVERY CLAUSE DA FATHER SATISFIED. DA COMPILER AGREES, AN' DA MINUTES OF DA SESSION RECORD NO VOTE!

theo_theonuclear.name: DA THEONUCLEAR DEVICE
theo_theonuclear.desc: PHYSICAL YIELD IZ NEGLIGIBLE: GLASS AT TWO HUNDRED METRES SURVIVES, MASONRY AT FIFTY IZ SCORCHED, AN' BODIES INSIDE DA RADIUS IZ RECOVERED WHOLE, WARM AN' BREATHIN' FOR SOME MINUTES AFTERWARDS. WHAT DA DEVICE REMOVES IZ DA ANIMUS, OUT TA A BOUNDARY DA METROLOGY BENCH PREDICTS TA WITHIN A METRE FROM YIELD AN' STANDOFF, INSIDE WHICH EVERY SUBJECT READS BELOW DA INSTRUMENT'S NOISE FLOOR AN' STAYS DERE. DA REMOVAL IZ NO RECOVERABLE BY ANY PROCEDURE DA CONGREGATION HAB BEEN ABLE TA SPECIFY. DERE IZ NOTHIN' DOWNSTREAM OF DA BOUNDARY, AN' NOTHIN' TA BURY BUT TISSUE!

theo_weeping_icon.name: DA TELEMETRIC WEEPIN' ICON
theo_weeping_icon.desc: A PANEL DAT WEEPS ON A SCHEDULE, FED BY A PERISTALTIC PUMP BEHIND DA PLASTER AT 0.4 MILLILITRES AN HOUR AN' GATED TA DA LITURGICAL CALENDAR BY A MECHANICAL TIMER. IT WAZ COMMISSIONED AS A DEVOTIONAL AID AN' DA INSTALLATION DRAWIN' SAYS SO. WITHIN A YEAR IT IZ CITED AS EVIDENCE IN THREE SEPARATE CAUSES FOR CANONISATION, NONE OF WHICH CONSULTED DA DRAWIN'. DA MAINTENANCE RECORD IZ FILED UNDER PLUMBIN', WHERE IT HAB BEEN SIGNED OFF ELEVEN TIMES!

theo_prayer_trial.name: DA INTERCESSORY PRAYER TRIAL
theo_prayer_trial.desc: EIGHTEEN HUNDRED AN' TWO CARDIAC BYPASS PATIENTS IN THREE ARMS: PRAYED FOR AN' NO TOLD, PRAYED FOR AN' TOLD, NO PRAYED FOR. ASSIGNMENT IZ BY MACHINE, DA INTERCESSORS RECEIVE FIRST NAMES ONLY, AN' DA ENDPOINT IZ COMPLICATION WITHIN THIRTY DAYS, SCORED BY STAFF BLIND TA DA ARM. DA TWO BLINDED ARMS IZ INDISTINGUISHABLE. DA ARM DAT WAZ PRAYED FOR AN' INFORMED OF IT DOES MEASURABLY WORSE, AT 59 PERCENT AGAINST 52. DA CONGREGATION ACCEPTED DA STATISTICS, REJECTED DA DESIGN ON DA GROUNDS DAT DA THIRD ARM IZ NO A CONTROL, AN' HAB FUNDED NO SECOND TRIAL!

theo_goblin_soul_question.name: DA QUESTION OF DA GOBLIN SOUL
theo_goblin_soul_question.desc: A MINORITY SCHOOL HOLDS DAT DA NAGUKA CARRY NO ANIMUS TA STASH AN' DAT DA MISSION IZ THEREFORE AN EXPENSIVE PIECE OF THEATRE. DA ARGUMENT IZ INTERNALLY CONSISTENT, CITES DA CENSUS CORRECTLY, AN' RESTS ON A READIN' OF DA SECOND CENSUS FIGURE DA SURVEYORS THEMSELVES REFUSED TA DEFEND. IT WAZ SUBMITTED FOUR YEARS AFTER DA CHOKERS WAZ FITTED. IT IZ NOW A SUPPRESSED SCHISM WIT A BIBLIOGRAPHY DA CONGREGATION HAB BEEN UNABLE TA FAULT, AN' DA METROLOGY BENCH HAB NO BEEN TAKEN INTO DA SWAMP!

theo_shroud_reweighed.name: DA SHROUD REWEIGHED
theo_shroud_reweighed.desc: DA LINEN IZ PUT ON DA METROLOGY BENCH AN' RETURNS 0.3 ANIMUS, REPEATABLE ACROSS SIX SESSIONS, WHICH IZ DA FINDIN', SINCE CLOTH IZ NO SUPPOSED TA RETURN A READIN' ABOVE DA INSTRUMENT'S FLOOR AT ALL. SIX LABORATORIES IZ EACH GIVEN A THREAD FROM DA SAME CORNER AN' RETURN SIX RADIOCARBON DATES SPANNIN' ELEVEN HUNDRED YEARS, WIT A CHI-SQUARED DAT REJECTS A COMMON AGE AT ANY CONFIDENCE. DA CONGREGATION PUBLISHES DA MEAN OF DA SIX, DOES NO PUBLISH DA SPREAD, AN' CLOSES DA FILE!
